comment: P4.d6 ensureHelpDocsSynced differential spec (v4 6c59b1ca bug 1 + 551f090b's trigger/prune/enqueue). ONE committed help tree (fixtures/help-ensure/help/: aurora.md + brahma-console.md) with the seed varying per scenario, so each scenario isolates exactly one trigger path. The contentHash values are the sha256 of each file's TRIMMED bytes, so a seeded row with that hash is 'unchanged' and the sync must leave it alone — which is what makes 'in-sync' a genuine no-sync and 'deleted' a genuine deleted-direction-only trigger. Each scenario builds its OWN database at $QT_FIXTURE_ENSURE_DIR/qt-ensure-<name>-main.db.

scenarios.name: empty-table
scenarios.note: The lazy gate that ALWAYS worked: no rows -> sync. The control.

scenarios.name: in-sync
scenarios.note: Every file has a row and every row has a file -> NO divergence -> no sync, no prune, no enqueue. The row's embedding is non-null so nothing is owed.

scenarios.name: added-doc
scenarios.note: v4 BUG 1: the table is POPULATED and aurora is unchanged, but brahma-console.md ships with no row. The old gate (existing.length > 0 -> return) left it invisible forever. Diverges via the UNSYNCED direction -> sync -> brahma created -> enqueued (its embedding is null).

scenarios.name: deleted-doc
scenarios.note: The DELETED direction is load-bearing: EVERY file on disk already has a row with a matching hash, so the unsynced direction cannot fire. Only the retired row (no file) can trigger this sync — and without the trigger the prune would be dead code.

scenarios.name: no-profile
scenarios.note: Same divergence as added-doc, but NO embedding profile is configured: the sync still completes and the docs are still listable; only the enqueue backs off (v4's debug-log-and-return).
